display_long_description:
Connect. Flow. Master the Grid.

Connect every matching dot in 3D using the fewest grabs possible.

Dots is a relaxing, skill-based spatial puzzle for Mixed Reality and immersive VR. Your goal is simple: connect matching colors until every dot is linked to at least one dot of the same color.

Grab a dot and move through neighboring dots of the same color to build a chain. The longer you continue without releasing, the better your run. Fewer grabs. Longer chains. Smarter routes.

---

How You Play

* Connect neighboring dots of the same color
* Build smooth chains in a single grab
* Every dot must connect to at least one matching dot
* Fewer grabs = better performance
* Replay levels to improve your routing and earn stronger results

---

Handcrafted levels introduce new layouts, shapes, and routing puzzles as you progress. Difficulty increases through smarter spatial design — not complicated rules.

Play fully immersed in VR or blend the puzzle into your real-world space with Mixed Reality support.

Early Demo – Your Feedback Matters

Dots is currently an early demo, and your feedback will help shape what comes next.

If you have ideas, feature requests, or anything that feels unclear or off, I’d love to hear from you.

What was your experience like?

* Did the dot size feel comfortable?
* Were the levels too large or too compact?
* Did the interaction feel natural?
* Was the difficulty curve clear and fair?

Your input directly influences future updates.
